# uscasestatus.com

> Free USCIS case status checker with plain-English explanations, timelines, processing-time context, email alerts, and growing nearby-case insights. Not affiliated with USCIS. Not legal advice.

## Primary
- [Home](https://uscasestatus.com/): Live case status lookup
- [Status guides](https://uscasestatus.com/status): Plain-English status explanations
- [Processing times](https://uscasestatus.com/processing-times): Published USCIS ranges by form
- [Insights](https://uscasestatus.com/insights): Corpus activity summary
- [Spanish home](https://uscasestatus.com/es): Misma app en español

## Notes
- Receipt format: 3-letter prefix + 10 digits (e.g. IOE0912345678)
- Data source: official USCIS Case Status API (Torch) when configured
- Always free; no ads
